candidate.title: Bulk set maximum rating for liked playlist items
candidate.applicability: Authenticated media APIs with user playlists, liked items, per-item reviews or ratings, and create/update endpoints.
procedure: Login and retain the access token for subsequent calls.
Read API docs for playlist library, liked items, review listing, review creation, and review update.
Paginate playlist library with the largest allowed page size; stop when a page returns fewer items.
Collect item IDs from all playlists into a set.
Paginate liked items similarly and build a liked-ID set.
Intersect playlist IDs with liked IDs to form targets.
For each target, query existing reviews filtered to the authenticated user.
Update any existing review whose rating is below the target maximum; create a new review only when none exists.
Re-query each target's user review to confirm the final rating.
pitfalls: Do not rate all liked items; restrict to items present in user playlists.
Do not assume an existing review exists; missing reviews require creation.
Do not create duplicate reviews before checking existing user reviews.
Respect rating bounds and only raise lower ratings when required.
Pagination defaults may be small; incomplete collection causes missed targets.
Verify after mutation because success messages alone may not prove final state.
